issues.title: Client: provision Meta Marketing API Sandbox Ad Account + token
issues.description:
As the client operator,
I want a Meta Marketing API Sandbox Ad Account and long-lived access token,
So that the agency can dogfood create_campaign without real ad spend.

## Context
Agency access model: client keeps production secrets and provisions sandbox credentials into a shared secure channel (not git). App Dashboard → Marketing API → Tools → Sandbox Ad Account (one per app). Link a Page you admin. Generate token with ads_management, ads_read, business_management (+ pages scopes per Meta use-case docs). Sandbox: no payment method; ads do not deliver; Insights often empty.

## Deliver to agency (names only in git)
- META_APP_ID
- META_APP_SECRET (nice-to-have)
- META_ACCESS_TOKEN (long-lived / sandbox)
- META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID (digits only, no act_ prefix)
- Account currency (USD/INR/…)
- Confirmation: sandbox=yes
acceptanceCriteria: Given a Meta developer app with Marketing API, when sandbox ad account is created, then Ad Account ID is available without act_ prefix
Given token generation, when scopes include ads_management and ads_read, then Graph Explorer can call act_{id}
Given handoff, when agency receives credentials out-of-band, then no secrets appear in git commits

issues.title: Configure Meta env + Settings reports Marketing API connected
issues.description:
As an ads-agent operator,
I want META_* set in .env.local and Settings to show Meta connected,
So that create_campaign(platform=meta) can call the Graph API.

## Context
env-status: meta requires META_ACCESS_TOKEN + META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID. Restart next after env change. Never commit .env.local.
acceptanceCriteria: Given META_ACCESS_TOKEN and META_AD_ACCOUNT_ID set, when Settings loads, then Meta Marketing API shows configured
Given missing token, when Settings loads, then Meta shows disconnected
Given .env.local changes, when git status is clean of secrets, then only .env.example docs may change

issues.title: Smoke createMetaCampaign against sandbox account
issues.description:
As an engineer,
I want a scripted or REPL smoke of createMetaCampaign,
So that Graph API auth/currency/objective errors surface before Desk UI dogfood.

## Context
createMetaCampaign({ name, dailyBudgetInr }) creates ACTIVE LINK_CLICKS campaign; daily_budget = round(dailyBudgetInr * 100). If sandbox currency ≠ INR semantics, fix conversion or rename field. Campaign shell only — no Ad Set/Ad.
acceptanceCriteria: Given configured Meta env, when createMetaCampaign runs, then a campaign id string is returned
Given API error (permissions/currency), when smoke fails, then error message is actionable (not empty)
Given success, when Ads API is queried, then campaign exists on sandbox account (Ads Manager may not show sandbox objects)

issues.title: Desk Approve create_campaign (platform=meta) end-to-end
issues.description:
As an operator on Desk,
I want to Approve a create_campaign proposal with platform meta,
So that the executor creates a Meta campaign and marks the local campaign active with externalId.

## Context
Path: approve → scheduled/executing → worker:proposals / executeCreateCampaign → createMetaCampaign. Conversational Campaigns→New is Google-shaped; Meta dogfood may use seeded proposal or minimal UI path. Ensure AUTH_BYPASS or session works locally. DB search_path must include adsagent (lib/db/client.ts).
acceptanceCriteria: Given a pending create_campaign proposal with platform meta and dailyBudgetInr, when operator Approves and undo window completes, then proposal status is executed (or failed with visible error)
Given success, when campaigns table is read, then externalId matches Meta campaign id
Given Reticle or manual check, when flow completes, then no 500 from metering/search_path

issues.title: Fix Meta budget currency units for sandbox account
issues.description:
As an engineer,
I want daily budget mapping correct for the sandbox account currency,
So that Meta accepts create/update budget without silent wrong amounts.

## Context
Field is named dailyBudgetInr but Meta expects minor units in account currency. Document or implement currency-aware conversion; add unit tests.
acceptanceCriteria: Given sandbox currency documented, when createMetaCampaign sets daily_budget, then value matches Meta minor-unit rules for that currency
Given unit tests, when budget helper runs, then INR and non-INR cases are covered or explicitly unsupported with clear error

issues.title: Write Meta sandbox dogfood runbook for agency

acceptanceCriteria: Given README or docs/agency-handoff, when engineer follows steps 1–N, then they reach executed Meta create without undocumented steps
Given Insights limitation, when runbook is read, then empty performance is called out as expected for sandbox

Given read surface tool list, when inspected, then mutate tools are absent

issues.title: Google Ads dogfood: New Campaign → Proposal → Approve → test customer
issues.description:
As an operator,
I want the documented Google dogfood checklist to succeed on a test customer,
So that gate integrity is proven beyond unit tests.

## Context
Campaigns → New Campaign → draft ready (finalUrl required) → Create Proposal → Approve → worker:proposals after undo → campaign in Google Ads UI or failed with visible error. Run npm run worker:proposals.
acceptanceCriteria: Given ready draft with https finalUrl, when Create Proposal + Approve completes, then proposal reaches executed or failed with visible error
Given executed, when Google Ads test account is checked, then Search campaign exists
Given isDraftReady gate, when finalUrl empty, then draft cannot be proposed as ready

issues.title: Reticle: save Desk Approve/Reject flows with intent

Given Reject flow, when driven, then proposal status updates and verdict passes

issues.title: Ensure app-data-mcp is documented as required for Hermes

Given compose, when app-data-mcp is up, then :8767 answers MCP HTTP
